items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Ron Welburn, Interviewer.

ctx.x: This is the interview with Fred Moore for the Jazz Oral History Project, March 30th, Wednesday, 1983, in the home of Mr. and Mrs. Moore in the Bronx, New York. My name is Ron Welburn, Interviewer. Fred Moore, good morning.
